item.title: Dozzle: A Convenient Real-Time Log Viewer for Docker Containers
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A step-by-step overview of Dozzle - a lightweight self-hosted tool for viewing Docker container logs in real time through a web interface. Installation via Docker Compose, setting up authentication, multi-host mode via agents, and recommendations for docker.sock security.

item.title: Diun: Notifications About Docker Image Updates
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A detailed guide to installing and configuring Diun for tracking Docker image updates. Covers deployment steps, integration with notification services, and monitoring automation, so you can update your containers on time and improve system security.
